beats.say: Who actually invented the World Wide Web?

label.s: Inventor of the World Wide Web

beats.say: Sir Tim Berners-Lee was born on 8 June 1955.
He proposed an information management system on 12 March 1989.
This proposal became the foundation for the web we use today.
Berners-Lee published the very first website on 20 December 1990.
In 2004, he was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his work.
He also received the 2016 Turing Award, the highest honour in computing.
